newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai lower at midday after early rise.
newsitem.headline: Bandai lower at midday after early rise.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd shares drifted lower by midday after rising early in Friday's session, inspired by news that it was merging with Sega Enterprises Ltd, brokers said.
By midday the shares were down 30 yen at 2,530 yen, after rising as high as 2,650 yen earlier in the session.
Brokers said the Bandai shares were in an adjustment phase and were expected to fluctuate until they came within close range of the the planned merger ratio.
In the merger planned for October 1, Bandai shareholders will receive 0.76 share of Sega for each share they own.
Sega shares were down 200 yen at 3,460 yen at midday.
